sources.entry: customtkinter - A modern and customizable Python UI library based on Tkinter.

summary.one_liner: CustomTkinter is a Python UI library that provides modern, customizable Tkinter-based widgets with light/dark and system-matching appearance modes.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Python UI library built on Tkinter that supplies new widgets styled to look modern and be fully customizable. Widgets are created and used like normal Tkinter widgets and can be mixed with standard Tkinter elements. Widgets and window colors either follow the system appearance or a manually set mode ('light' or 'dark'). The README says widgets support HighDPI scaling on Windows and macOS, and it shows a button with image support, scrollable frames (vertical or horizontal), and a TkinterMapView integration. It also mentions a 'run_showroom()' demo app that displays all available widgets. Themes named in the example are blue (default), dark-blue, and green.
use_cases: build a desktop GUI in Python with a modern look
add dark mode support to a Tkinter application
create scrollable frames in a Tkinter app
put image buttons in a Python desktop program
embed an OpenStreetMap tile map in a Tkinter UI
prototype cross-platform desktop interfaces on Windows, macOS and Linux
notable: Widgets are used like normal Tkinter widgets and can be mixed with standard Tk elements
Appearance follows the system light/dark setting or a manually set mode
HighDPI scaling support on Windows and macOS
Includes a showroom demo via run_showroom()
caveats: The README says the library is under active development, so APIs may change between versions
On macOS, a dark window header requires Python 3.10+ or Anaconda Python with Tcl/Tk 8.6.9 or higher
HighDPI scaling is stated for Windows and macOS only
